ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Surah Naas? (1 mark)
   A. Use Surah Naas to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Surah Naas has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Surah Naas with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah Naas.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   C. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings able to:? (1 mark)

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   C. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.
   C. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of? (1 mark)

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

11. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)

   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
